answer: My mechanism is a bonded trellis of identities. Each miner stakes 5,000 tokens into a contract that assigns a random walnut-sized nonce, then registers on a public mesa of active peers. To earn, you must attest for others and get attested; each attestation costs 0.02 tokens and burns on failure. Faking 1,000 sybils means locking 5 million tokens plus roughly $14,000 in gas and hardware, and you forfeit the entire stake the moment attestations diverge from the recorded nonces. Honest miners recoup the bond in about 40 hours of steady attestation work on a single 8-core box.
